Source review completed at d97027c8368c4bdd5b2044a3d837e2b3f53db24b (code-bearing revision 204eff7e74075906e96e6dd476a418e21ae1d772). No implementation blockers found in the combined prepared update / live hierarchy refresh path.

The implementation follows the accepted C3-2 boundary: prospective validation and native numerical staging before claims; stable packet identity and preservation of untouched dirty slots/selectors/history; affected ancestor repair and old/new recipient invalidation; one generation publication; healthy pre-claim rejection and unready late failure. Tests cover exact-count edits invisible to floating-point representations, slot holes and capture rebinding, repeated occurrence reuse, survivor preservation, resource rejection, and compiler write contracts.

Hosted acceptance is NOT yet complete. On 2026-10-30, run 41101471179 / native-cpu job 124219287541 at 204eff7:
- Actual hosted CPU CTest passed 101/101 in 3353.15 seconds.
- Compiler module collection/audit completed.
- The additional four-mode no-unroll hierarchy/refresh step was cancelled.
- PostgreSQL-to-active integration and the final CPU-only backend check were skipped.
The job ran 17:46:59–19:17:23 UTC against timeout-minutes: 90, consistent with exhausting the overall job budget. This is not an observed failing physics assertion. Contributor-retained local results remain separate evidence and do not replace these missing hosted steps.

Disposition: leave open pending complete hosted native acceptance. Next contributing-agent action is a narrow CI-budget correction (increase the current 90-minute budget to accommodate the expanded sequential suite, or split the workload while preserving all acceptance modes), followed by one replacement hosted run. Do not remove coverage or rerun the unchanged 90-minute workflow blindly. Maintainer then verifies all remaining hosted steps and merges if green and source unchanged apart from the reviewed workflow correction. No CI was launched by this review.

Core state: C3-2 implements structural refresh for the installed live hierarchy, with fixture-only new-body starts. Native operational admission/contact-safe candidate ticks remain the next core item, followed by the enduring prepared owner and observable command-line path. This review makes no CUDA refresh acceptance claim.

Accepted following completed hosted validation on 2026-10-30. Replacement run 41123391538 / native-cpu job 124295521781 at 904f2bc completed successfully: 101/101 CPU tests in 3355.27 seconds, all four no-unroll hierarchy and refresh modes, compiler collection/audit, PostgreSQL-to-active integration (180 checks, private_reads=0), and final CPU-only backend verification. All nine checks are green. Total native job duration was approximately 95 minutes.

Reviewed the delta from d97027c through f4c5ba9: the only executable workflow change raises the timeout from 90 to 150 minutes; acceptance commands and modes are unchanged. Remaining changes are documentation and retained evidence. No engine source or test assertions changed after the previous source review. The pending-hosted wording in the documentation is superseded by this acceptance record.

C3-2 is accepted for CPU structural live-hierarchy refresh. Native operational admission/contact-safe candidate ticks remain next, then enduring prepared owners and observable study controls. CUDA refresh qualification remains separate. Proceeding to merge; no manual rerun requested.
